2:47 p.m. You're three stories up — nail gun in one hand, shingle in the other — and your phone is buzzing in the truck.

You already know how this ends. By the time your boots hit the ground, it's a voicemail. And nobody leaves those anymore. They just call the next name on the list.

That call was a job. So was the one at 7:10 this morning. They add up quietly, because a missed call never sends you an invoice.

That's the part I handle. Every ring gets answered — after hours, on the roof, all of it. Booked, not lost.

For the social manager
Director's notes

For Dara — why this works, and how to make more.

The format is a formula. Swap the trade, keep the beats, and Malik stays Malik every time.

The lever

Don't have Malik explain AI. Drop him inside the owner's worst 30 seconds, then make him the one who catches the call. The humor comes from the situation — hands full, phone just out of reach — never from making the owner look dumb.

The 7-beat formula (reusable)
  1. 1Hook — the owner physically can't reach the phone (specific, visual, a little funny).
  2. 2Stakes — what that one call is worth (always hedge with "industry estimate").
  3. 3The knife — nobody leaves voicemails; they call the next guy.
  4. 4The pile-up — a comedic end-of-day tally.
  5. 5The turn — Malik handles it; his line is "I got this one."
  6. 6The after — booked while you worked.
  7. 7CTA — the free Revenue Leak Scorecard.
5 scenario swaps — same skeleton, new trade
  • Plumberboth arms under the sink, water running.
  • Barbermid-fade, can't stop or he ruins it.
  • Catererboth hands in a hot tray during the dinner rush.
  • Salon ownerfoils in a client's hair, timer running.
  • HVAC techin a crawlspace, phone up in the van.
Guardrails (from the Creative Pack)
  • Plain English
  • No slang
  • No emojis in slides
  • Every number says "estimate"
  • Dollars, never credits
  • CTA is always the Scorecard
  • Tagline: AI Marketing Made Easy
  • Keep the AI-disclosure line on the CTA slide
  • Malik points at what he's talking about
